I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random. I noted the correction: Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form is due 24 September.

I also pointed out that 24 September is already three weeks gone (today is 14 October on the simulation clock). So either the deadline has passed or the date is still wrong. I asked them to tell me if they meant a date that's still ahead.

That was the only thing I did. I didn't read #north-team, and I didn't change anything else.
